annotations.title: Is the clinical pipeline for this condition crowding?

description: Use when the user is sizing a therapeutic area, diligencing a biotech or medtech target, or asks how many companies are running trials for a condition: "how crowded is the obesity pipeline?", "who sponsors the most trials in this disease?". Returns interventional trials started per year from ClinicalTrials.gov (all, industry-sponsored, Phase 3), whether industry starts are rising or falling, and the top industry sponsors with the top-5 share. Refuses before you are charged if the condition matches nothing or the counts do not reconcile. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: built in: by start year (years); segment: industry, Phase 3, sponsor (in the result). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For FDA clearances in a device category, use run_device_clearances; for recalls in a product category, use run_recall_watch; for how many adults in a state are recorded as having the condition, use run_condition_prevalence.
